summary: The safe variant is an evidence-first integration pipeline with deterministic foundations, machine review, result-focused human sampling and periodic whole-system checks.

items.text: Run named and independently calibrated review agents before integration, with deterministic checks taking precedence over prose verdicts.
Make build, test, contract and security checks an executable safety net over the exact merge candidate.
Present operators with a structured review result and sample green changes according to risk instead of reading every diff by default.
Use scheduled sweeps to detect integrated drift and correlated misses that no individual change gate can see.
